name: create_task
description: Create a background Task and immediately return its ID. Include goal, context, constraints and deliverables in text. Interpret applicable AGENTS.md routing rules semantically using available configured Providers, models and Agent capabilities. Explicit current-task choices take precedence; otherwise retain existing defaults. Never silently substitute an unavailable preferred executor. Every Task uses Agent Link, including local execution. Omit executor, link_id and target for an ordinary local Task. executor=agent selects a node advertising task_executor; use link_id to choose one, or omit it only when exactly one capable connected node is reachable. Do not combine executor with an assistant target. For an assistant Task on a connected node, provide link_id and optionally target from list_assistants; omission resolves the receiving node’s persisted default assistant. The receiving Adapter owns models, permissions, credentials, workspace and execution. Linked Tasks reject local profile, model, Skills and requirements; explicit executor Tasks also reject workspace overrides. For ordinary local Git development select workspace.kind=worktree and source project_dir; reuse an existing worktree or an explicitly requested in-place project with kind=directory. Without a project use temporary. The local Adapter prepares the workspace, refreshes the remote base and creates managed worktrees before starting the Agent. Keep setup metadata out of the execution text; the Agent receives its cwd. Files are not copied between workspaces. Create a Task for new work; use send_message for owner guidance or continuation only when the receiver supports it. Approval forwarding is available only where advertised and remains bound to the original Task and caller; assistant messages carry no approval authority. The text must contain a concise title on its first line AND complete instructions on following lines. A title-only brief is rejected. Preserve the user’s exact commands and constraints; the executing Agent does not see the chat.

profile.description: Configured Provider connection Profile ID for an ordinary local Task. Omit to use the invoking assistant’s active configuration. No user allowlist or route confirmation is needed. Unsupported for linked Tasks.

desktop.description: Native desktop automation is currently unsupported. Independent headless browser automation does not require desktop=true.

requirements.description: Local execution requirements; unsupported for linked Tasks.

selection_reason.description: Concise creation-time reason for the chosen executor; do not claim certainty for ambiguous work.

skills.description: Local global skill names for an ordinary local Task. Omitted or empty loads no global skills. Project skills are discovered independently. Unsupported for linked Tasks.

model.description: Concrete model ID for an ordinary local Task. Omit to use the selected Provider’s default, or the invoking assistant’s active model when no Provider is selected. Unsupported for linked Tasks.

workspace.description: Workspace intent for an ordinary local Task; the local Adapter prepares and binds the path. Linked assistant Tasks may accept a destination directory hint. Explicit executor Tasks use the receiver’s configured scope and reject overrides.

project_dir.description: Existing absolute source project path on the selected execution machine; omit for temporary.

remote.description: Optional Git remote; otherwise origin or the sole remote.

base.description: Optional remote base branch; otherwise discover the remote default branch.

branch.description: Optional new feature branch; otherwise the local Adapter generates a unique feature branch.

commit.description: Optional exact pinned commit instead of updating a base branch.

link_id.description: Agent Link connection ID from list_execution_targets. Ordinary Tasks omit it for local execution. With executor=agent, omission requires exactly one reachable capable node.

target.description: Explicit receiving assistant address from list_assistants. Omit to use the receiving node’s persisted default.

executor.description: Select the node’s advertised task_executor capability. Use link_id when multiple capable nodes are connected; do not supply target. Omit for ordinary assistant Task routing. Execution controls depend on the receiving Adapter’s advertised capabilities.

name: list_tasks
description: Search task metadata by state and title/ID. Defaults to active tasks, 10 per page; archived tasks keep complete/cancelled status. Use attention for failed/interrupted, archived to find past results, all only with a relevant query. Follow next_offset only when needed; no polling.

phase.description: Exact execution status; overrides scope when provided

q.description: Case-insensitive title or task ID substring

name: get_task
description: Read recent results and execution state of a task.

name: set_task_dispositions
description: Set archive decisions for 1–8 ended Tasks in one atomic batch. archived=true archives a Task; false retains it for follow-up. Run completion does not archive automatically. Supply the current run_id from task metadata or the result event and a concise reason. Pending input or a newer/running run rejects stale decisions. Archiving retains context and workspace; worktree contents do not constrain this operation. During background result processing, only runs in the delivered batch can be changed.

name: send_message
description: Send a durable message to a Task or assistant using its address and text. Runtime binds the real sender, provenance and reply linkage. Ordinary local Tasks receive owner guidance or peer reference at a model boundary; new owner guidance can reopen an ended local Task in its retained workspace. Linked Task guidance and continuation require the receiving Adapter’s task input capability and may reject active-run input. Peer references cannot become owner guidance or restart ended Tasks. Returns acceptance, never execution completion. Runtime reports final Task results automatically; do not send completion yourself.

name: interrupt
description: Interrupt current work where the receiving Adapter supports interruption, retaining Task/session/files and pending guidance. Linked Tasks currently do not support interruption. Does not replay interrupted input or automatically resume. Local work retains capacity until cleanup is confirmed; later owner guidance can continue the same Task. Completed results remain complete.

name: cancel_task
description: Request cancellation where the receiving Adapter supports it. Cancellation intent is durable; acceptance does not confirm execution has stopped. Local Tasks discard pending guidance and become cancelled and archived after confirmed cleanup. Linked Tasks retain their last accepted state until the receiver confirms a terminal outcome; their archive state is independent. History and files remain. Completed results remain complete.

name: list_schedules
description: List scheduled plans (metadata only). Filter enabled/paused/all; use pagination.

name: get_schedule
description: Read a schedule definition and paginated execution history.

name: manage_schedule
description: Create/update/pause/resume/delete/run a persistent schedule. Pausing/deleting prevents future triggers and does not cancel current work. An immediate run is non-overlapping. Calendar recurrence uses five-field Cron. Omitted timezone defaults to the owning Control system IANA zone on create; updates preserve the saved zone. Saved zones stay fixed when the system zone changes. Explicit timezone overrides the default. Control triggers a new task on the saved machine; each dispatch reads that machine's current execution policy. Omit machine_id on update to preserve the selected machine. Creation/update requires spec. Deletion is soft and keeps execution history.

timezone.description: Optional IANA name. Defaults to owning Control system zone at creation, saved thereafter; omitted on update preserves the saved zone.

profile.description: Configured Provider Profile ID chosen autonomously. Omit to snapshot the owning assistant’s configuration at each trigger.

desktop.description: Native desktop automation is currently unsupported. Independent headless browser automation does not require desktop=true.

machine_id.description: Machine to run on. Each occurrence reads its current execution policy and creates a fresh Task. Omit on update to retain the machine.

model.description: Concrete model supported by the selected configured Provider.

cron.description: cron: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. Lists, ranges, steps, month/weekday names supported; Sunday=0. Restricted DOM and DOW match either. No seconds, macros, ?, L, W or #. Example: 0 8-20 * * * runs hourly 08:00 through 20:00. DST gaps skipped; repeated wall times run once at the earlier instant.

name: list_execution_targets
description: List this autonomous node and its Agent Link connections, provided assistants and advertised capabilities. Remote nodes own execution and authorization. No Control/Runner enrollment is required.

name: list_assistants
description: List addressable assistants in this Control and Spaces connected through the App relay. A listed remote assistant may be offline. Does not start work.

name: get_model_catalog
description: Discover configured Provider profiles with offset/limit, or supply profile for its model facts. models and configured_models are separately paginated with the same offset/limit and report their totals.
